title: AI Tool Side-Effect & Revoke — v6
description: AI write side-effect list item / execution-trace traceItem / single-revoke result / conversation-level batch result (G1). Frozen enums: status=executed|revoked|revoking_external|revoke_failed; revokeClass=none|local_compensate|governed_external|transactional (KB-6: local_compensate ≠ governed_external, never claim revoked falsely); revokeStatus=revoked|compensating|revoke_failed. v6 (2026-10-20): `item` and `traceItem` gain an optional `executionId` — the correlation key for the one governed execution that wrote this row, the same value the audit row of that execution carries. Additive: not in `required`, so v5-shaped payloads stay valid; both objects remain `additionalProperties:false`, so a consumer validating against v5 rejects a v6 payload that carries it — consumers must follow the version, and a new consumer can finally pair an effect with its audit row precisely instead of by tool + user + time. v5 (2026-10-17, JV-65): `item` and `traceItem` gained an optional `userId` — who initiated this write. Additive: not in `required`, so v4-shaped payloads stayed valid; both objects remain `additionalProperties:false`, so a consumer validating against v4 rejects a v5 payload that carries it — consumers must follow the version, and a new consumer can finally read who. v4 (2026-10-03, REV-16): `revokeResult` gained three keys that were actually being sent but never declared — `downstreamReferences` (the rows the revoke did not reach: present only when the type has a reference model, empty array = checked and none, field absent = the type has no reference model and was not checked; the decision and the cascade are unchanged), `skipped` and `reason` (the idempotent-skip marker and reason of a single revoke, always sent). `additionalProperties` stayed true, so old consumers were unaffected; that version only moved already-sent keys into the declared surface. v3: cascade compensation (docs/cascade-compensation.spec.md) — item/traceItem gained `compensationGroup` (the idempotency base key of that call; same group = one business action; null = historical single-target row) and `parentEffectId` (the effect id of the root side effect; null = root member or single-target row); revokeResult gained the `cascade` summary (aggregated per-member results; absent for a single-target revoke). revokeResult/revokeBatch.results were already additionalProperties:true, so `cascade` did not require its own object version. Source: src/ai/tool-effects/ai-tool-effects.service.ts listOwned/listForConversation; src/ai/tool-effects/effect-composition.ts; src/ai/interfaces/tool.interface.ts. / v6（2026-10-20）：`item` 与 `traceItem` 加**可选** `executionId` —— 写下本行的那一次受治理执行的关联键，与这次执行的审计行**同值**。**加性**：不进 `required`，故 v5 形态的载荷仍合法；两个对象仍是 `additionalProperties:false`，故**按 v5 schema 校验的消费者会拒掉带 `executionId` 的 v6 载荷** —— 消费方须跟上版本，而新消费者终于能把一条副作用与它的审计行**精确**配上，而不必靠 tool + user + 时间。**v5**：v5（2026-10-17，JV-65）：`item` 与 `traceItem` 加**可选** `userId` —— 这次写由**谁**发起。加性：不进 `required`，故 v4 形态的载荷仍合法；两个对象仍是 `additionalProperties:false`，故**按 v4 schema 校验的消费者会拒掉带 `userId` 的 v5 载荷** —— 消费方须跟上版本，而新消费者终于读得出「谁」。**v4**：v4（2026-10-03，REV-16）：`revokeResult` 补上三个**实际已在发出、却未声明**的键 —— `downstreamReferences`（撤销**没够到**的那些行：类型有引用模型时才有该字段，**空数组=查过且没有**，**字段缺席=该类型没有引用模型、未检查**；判定不因此改变、也不级联）、`skipped` 与 `reason`（单条撤销的幂等跳过标记与原因，一直在发）。`additionalProperties` 仍为 true，故**旧消费者不受影响**；本次只是把已发的键补进声明面。AI 写副作用清单 item / 执行轨迹 traceItem / 单条撤销结果 / 会话级批量结果（G1）。枚举冻结：status=executed|revoked|revoking_external|revoke_failed；revokeClass=none|local_compensate|governed_external|transactional（KB-6：local_compensate≠governed_external，永不谎称 revoked）；revokeStatus=revoked|compensating|revoke_failed。**v3 变更**：级联补偿（docs/cascade-compensation.spec.md）——item/traceItem 加 `compensationGroup`（= 该次调用的幂等基键，同组=同一业务动作；null=历史单目标行）与 `parentEffectId`（根副作用的 effect id；null=根成员或单目标行）；revokeResult 加 `cascade` 汇总（组内逐条结果聚合；单目标撤销时不出现）。revokeResult/revokeBatch.results 本就是 additionalProperties:true，故加 cascade 不单独升级对象。来源：src/ai/tool-effects/ai-tool-effects.service.ts listOwned/listForConversation; src/ai/tool-effects/effect-composition.ts; src/ai/interfaces/tool.interface.ts。

userId.description: 发起这次写的调用方（JV-65）。可选：v4 形态的载荷不携带它仍然合法，而载荷一旦携带，它必须是一个字符串 id

compensationGroup.description: 级联补偿组 = 该次工具调用的幂等基键；同组 = 同一业务动作的多表副作用。null = 历史/单目标副作用行

parentEffectId.description: 根副作用的 effect id（组内主体对象）；null = 该行即根成员，或单目标副作用行

executionId.description: Correlation key for the one governed execution that wrote this row — the same value on the audit row of that execution; chain-external, never in the hash payload. Optional: null or absent when the runtime has no execution-id concept, or when the row was not written by a tool execution. / 写下本行的那一次受治理执行的关联键，与这次执行的审计行同值；链外列，不入 hash payload。可选：本运行时没有该概念、或本行不是一次工具执行写下时为 null/省略。

changeSummary.description: D2：AI 决策证据 ↔ 实际状态变化的紧凑摘要（不回显全量快照，控载荷）

cascade.description: 级联补偿汇总（仅当该副作用属于多成员组时出现；单目标撤销不返回此键）
